1972.notes: Canton Codified Ordinances § 181.14(d)-(e) (Allocation of funds; American Legal Publishing) narrates the rate history: increases from 1% to 1.3% effective September 1, 1968, to 1.4% effective January 1, 1969 and to 1.5% effective January 1, 1970 (Ord. 200-68, passed by voters 6-20-68), then from 1.5% to 1.9% effective October 1, 1981 and from 1.9% to 2% effective October 1, 1982 (Ord. 239-84, passed 12-17-84); § 181.03 levies 2.0% on and after October 1, 1982. So 1.5% applied from January 1, 1970 until October 1, 1981, including all of 1972; the ACIR Significant Features of Fiscal Federalism editions print 1.5% at December 31, 1970 and 1971, July 1, 1973, July 1, 1976 and October 1, 1979. No document for 1972 itself.
